resources.string: Use 720p for compatibility. This changes the video mode reported to the game and requires restarting it. To increase detail, use Render scale below; select 1080p here only for games that support that mode.

* Sizes assume a game rendering at 1280×720. Actual dimensions depend on the game and which surfaces can be scaled. For a 1080p test, keep PS3 video mode at 720p and use 150%. Higher scales increase GPU load and memory use; restart for comparable tests.
